validation.authority: same raw authority prefix; no SQL authorization
validation.W2_order: exact ordered page equals engine result

method.explain_target: EXPLAIN EXECUTE exact prepared handle, shared by identical SQL
method.wall: plain prepared queries, simple utility framing, raw Row buffering; no JSON/native-record decoding or Rust semantics
method.bytes: binary field payload and DataRow framing; excludes RowDescription, CommandComplete, ReadyForQuery, inbound/transport framing
method.fresh: actual new Engine::seed_at fixture and typed copy; no statistics/catalog reset in canonical matrix
method.counterfactual: one statement bounded facts vs native typed record-array facts; no SQL authority decision or unread arithmetic
